_doc: Risky Rails tracking plan: the single source for RR_AnalyticsPlan.lua and TRACKING_PLAN.md (track.py build). Every event names the decision it informs. Field values are enums or numeric buckets so dashboard cardinality stays bounded; the player argument already carries the UserId, so no field may hold names, ids or free text. Custom fields map in order to CustomField01..03; an experiment tag takes the next free slot.

currency.name: Coins
currency.note: data name per OQ-003 default C (player-facing '$'); change with the owner's decision

onboarding.question: Where do first-time players drop before their first banked fare and first finished run?

steps.name: Joined
steps.where: lobby PlayerAdded, first session only (profile flag)

trip.question: Which part of a trip loses crews: queue, boarding, first fork, first bank or arrival?
trip.session: trip id made in the lobby and sent in TeleportData next to the canon UserIds (tech.data.teleport_data). Funnels are per player: log each step for every crew member it applies to (a step logged without the earlier ones marks them complete, so a missing hook hides the drop instead of showing zero)

steps.name: Boarded
steps.where: trip place: each player loaded on the train

steps.name: Departed
steps.where: trip place: whistle / depart (every crew member on board)

steps.name: First fork
steps.where: first junction resolved (every crew member on board, not only the lever puller)

steps.name: Arrived
steps.where: terminus arrival, not a fail (every crew member)

supply.question: Does the Depotron order flow lose players between opening and fetching the crate?
supply.session: one id per terminal open (HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)), owned by the player who opened the terminal: every step of that session is logged on that player, even when a crewmate fetches the crate

steps.name: Order placed
steps.where: server accepted the order and took the coins (the opener)

steps.name: Crate fetched
steps.where: crate picked up from the roof (logged on the orderer; crate_resolved goes to the fetcher)

purchase.question: Where do Robux purchases fail: prompt shown, accepted, or granted?
purchase.session: one id per prompt; RR_AnalyticsHooks keeps the latest prompt id per player and product

steps.name: Granted
steps.where: developer product: after the receipt handler saved the grant and returns PurchaseGranted; game pass: after the server applied the pass on PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished (ownership via UserOwnsGamePassAsync). Passes never reach ProcessReceipt (Hooks.purchaseGranted)

economy.question: Do faucets and sinks match the economy sim? Which sinks carry the economy?

sources.where: station payout, per player, after the server adds the coins (Hooks.stationPaid)
developer product receipt handler, after the grant is saved (Hooks.farePackGranted)
developer product receipt handler, after the grant is saved (Hooks.farePackGranted)
developer product receipt handler, after the grant is saved (Hooks.farePackGranted)
code redeem, after the coins are saved (Hooks.promoRedeemed; custom type: codes are not a schedule)

sinks.where: Depotron order accepted, on the player who paid (Hooks.orderAccepted)
Depotron order accepted, on the player who paid (Hooks.orderAccepted)
Depotron order accepted, on the player who paid (Hooks.orderAccepted)
Depotron order accepted, on the player who paid (Hooks.orderAccepted)

trip.question: Completion rate per difficulty (canon target release.kpi.completion) and how far failed trips get.
trip.where: Start at depart (Hooks.tripDeparted), Complete at arrival and Fail at the fail cinematic (Hooks.runEnded)

locomotives.question: How long until each unlock (canon gameplay.progress.*) versus the economy sim?
locomotives.where: Complete when the unlock is saved (Hooks.unlockBought)

lines.question: When do players open the second line (canon gameplay.progress.ladder) versus the economy sim?
lines.where: Complete when the unlock is saved (Hooks.unlockBought)

events.question: Is the fork a real choice (risky share by difficulty) and do crews pull in time?
events.value: seconds left on the gantry countdown

events.question: Why do runs end, and how often at each difficulty?
In which phase do players quit (lobby, queue, boarding, run, results)?
Which crisis systems fail crews, and how long fixes take (four_systems balance)?
events.value: seconds from alert to fix or fail

events.question: Does the results screen drive re-queues and invites (gameplay.results.*)?
Do Depotron crates get fetched or slide off, and how long do crews take (supply flow, gameplay.supplies.flow)?
events.where: server crate handler, once per crate (Hooks.crateResolved, on the fetcher; on the orderer when it slid off)
events.value: seconds from landing to fetch or slide-off

experiments._doc: Plan first (abtest.py plan), then set active true. salt reshuffles arms; tag = event ids, funnel ids or 'onboarding' whose next free custom field carries 'experiment:arm'.

example_onboarding_hint.who: new players only: call expose() at their first join
